overview: Built an inbound voice receptionist for Coastal Home & Estate Management to handle customer calls, collect caller information, answer common questions, and assist with appointment booking.
The system connects ElevenLabs with n8n and GoHighLevel to move caller information directly into the CRM.

blocks.p: ElevenLabs | n8n | GoHighLevel | Voice Automation | CRM | Appointment Booking
Configured a dedicated voice receptionist named Olivia to handle incoming calls.
Inbound Call↓ElevenLabs Voice Receptionist↓Caller Information↓n8n Automation↓GoHighLevel CRM↓Contact Update↓Appointment Booking
n8n processes the information collected during the call and sends it to GoHighLevel.
Appointment requests are also connected to the booking process, reducing the need for manual scheduling and data entry.

result: A complete inbound call automation system that connects customer calls, information capture, appointment booking, and CRM updates in one workflow.
The setup reduces repetitive receptionist work, speeds up lead handling, and keeps customer information organized automatically.
